title: Grid Movement and Collision: From Rules to Implementation
subtitle: This article deconstructs the layered mechanism for grid-based movement and collision detection, built upon grid coordinates and physics tags. It details the push-box displacement logic and blockage checks using an occupancy table and reachability model, providing a direct technical path from rule definition to code implementation to help readers master core physics interaction principles.
